subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open conflicting fork PR, ask that author to rebase it, or defer this Feishu reply-mention bug for now?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and still present, but a conflicting fork PR already targets it and the earlier same-repository branch was closed unmerged with proof, gating, and root-routing concerns.

options.title: Adopt Or Replace The Candidate
options.body: Use the existing branch only as source context and land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific mention evidence, routing tests, and live/redacted Feishu proof.

options.title: Wait For The Fork Author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork PR author to rebase and address the previous safety concerns before review continues.

options.title: Defer Feishu Reply Work
options.body: Leave this as a known Feishu channel bug without queueing another repair lane until channel ownership bandwidth is available.

recommendation.title: Adopt Or Replace The Candidate
recommendation.body: Use the existing branch only as source context and land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific mention evidence, routing tests, and live/redacted Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention-handling work makes this the closest routing candidate for the safe mention-detection shape.
